{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: GitLab and GitHub API tokens stay out of the model context — encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM), tools on demand, web settings panel.","id":"gh:1333885826","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-git-credentials","slug":"revive/dsh-git-credentials","topics":["bitbucket","cordis","dsh","dsh-plugin","gitea","gitee","github","gitlab"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: GitLab and GitHub API tokens stay out of the model context — encrypted at r"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"est (AES-256-GCM), tools on demand, web settings panel."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-git-credentials"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An out-of-tree plugin for DeepSeek Harness that manages GitLab, GitHub, Gitee, Gitea, and Bitbucket "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"API tokens so **token values never enter the model context**."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The model's tools carry only a *site id* (e.g. `corp`); that site's token is decrypted from the plug"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"in's own encrypted store at call time and appears only in the outgoing HTTP `Authorization` header. "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"Changing a site or rotating its token takes effect on the very next call — no restart required."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Tokens stay out of the model context** — never in tool arguments, return values, or error messag"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"es; only business data (`site`, `project`, `path`, …) crosses the model boundary
- **Encrypted at re"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"st** — AES-256-GCM encrypted data file with a separate 32-byte random key file (`0600`, atomic write"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"s)
- **Per-provider tool scoping** — `gitlab_*` tools only see GitLab sites, `github_*` only GitHub "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"sites, and likewise for `gitee_*`, `gitea_*`, `bitbucket_*`; unconfigured sites/tokens fail loud wit"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"h the valid values listed in the error
- **Web settings panel** — add, edit, and delete sites; store"},{"id":"p7s7","text":" or clear token values; **no response ever carries a token value**, only configured state
- **Hot lo"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"ad/unload** — mounts and unmounts on a running GUI without restarting it
- **Instant effect** — each"},{"id":"p7s9","text":" tool call reads a freshly decrypted snapshot, so edits and rotations apply immediately"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Why not just an MCP server?"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"GitHub publishes an official MCP server, and the harness supports MCP clients natively — for GitHub-"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"only automation, wiring up the official MCP server is the mainstream choice, and this plugin's `gith"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ub_*` tools do overlap with it."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"This plugin earns its place where MCP servers don't cover the gap:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| | Official GitHub MCP | This plugin |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Forges | GitHub only (GitLab has an official server; Gitee / Gitea / Bitbucket rely on third-party"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" servers of varying quality and maintenance) | One encrypted store, one settings panel, one tool set"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" for GitLab, GitHub, Gitee, Gitea, and Bitbucket — including self-hosted Gitea / GitLab |
| Token ha"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ndling | Plaintext environment variables per server, no management UI | AES-256-GCM encrypted storag"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"e, one token per site, settings-page management; token values never enter the model context |
| Inte"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"gration | Extra MCP proxy process | Tools register directly in the harness tool registry |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Use the MCP route for a single hosted forge with standard token handling; use this plugin for multi-"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"forge setups (especially Gitee or self-hosted Gitea), or when you want encrypted storage plus an in-"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"product management page."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Storage"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- `~/.dsh/git-credentials.json` — data file, fully encrypted with AES-256-GCM (`0600`, atomic write)"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"
- `~/.dsh/git-credentials.key` — 32-byte random key, stored as a separate file (`0600`)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Threat model"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Scenario | Protected? |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| A human copies/backs up/syncs the **data file** | ✅ Yes — ciphertext only; without the key file it"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" cannot be decrypted |
| A **same-UID process** (e.g. the agent's bash/fs tools) reads both files | "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"❌ No — the key sits beside the data with the same permissions; same level as the harness's own key h"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"andling ("discretion, not a boundary") |
| The **user deliberately** asks the model to read the file"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"s | ❌ No — out of scope; no system can stop that |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Losing the key file means the data is unrecoverable (decryption fails loud and reports the key path)"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"; a copied data file alone is safe."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Option A: install the release tarball (recommended)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Download `dsh-git-credentials-<version>.tgz` from the releases page — the tarball ships the built br"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"owser bundle, so no harness checkout or build step is needed — then install it into a profile with t"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" so no harness checkout or build step is needed — then install it into a profile with the `dsh` CLI:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The first use initializes the profile, pnpm links the package, and `dsh` appends the plugin to the p"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"rofile's bundle layers. After the res"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"tart, the plugin appears under **Settings → Git Credentials**."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Option B: install from a source checkout"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The plugin is a pure add-on — zero changes to harness code. Uninstalling ="},{"id":"p34s3","text":" removing both entries."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"> The browser half (`lib/client.js`) is a build artifact — after cloning, build it first (see Develo"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"pment). The release tarball already contains it."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Manage sites and tokens in **Settings → Git Credentials**:"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"- **Add a site**: the form sits in its own **Add site** card below the configured list, with site id"},{"id":"p38s2","text":", provider (GitLab / GitHub / Gitee / Gitea / Bitbucket), API base URL (defaults per provider: `http"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"s://api.github.com`, `https://gitee.com/api/v5`, `https://api.bitbucket.org/2.0`; GitLab and Gitea a"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"re self-hosted and need their own address, e.g. `https://gitlab.example.com` / `https://gitea.exampl"},{"id":"p38s5","text":"e.com/api/v1`), the site's token, and an optional default project. One **Save** writes the site and "},{"id":"p38s6","text":"its token together; the field rules (site id charset, http(s) base URL) appear as field help, and an"},{"id":"p38s7","text":" invalid draft says what is wrong and disables Save instead of failing server-side
